dashboard.description: Status of the bare metal nodes belonging to the compute cluster.

panels.description: Inventory hosts HTCondor does not see. Should be 0.

targets.query: SELECT count("v") FROM (SELECT last("in_condor") AS "v" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host") WHERE "v" = 0

panels.title: Missing

panels.description: Inventory hosts currently advertising a slot to HTCondor.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") FROM (SELECT last("in_condor") AS "v" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: In pool

panels.description: Hosts listed in the VGCN inventory (vgcn-infrastructure-playbook/hosts).

targets.query: SELECT count("v") FROM (SELECT last("in_condor") AS "v" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: Expected

panels.description: Current total power draw of all bare metal hosts (IPMI DCMI, 5 s average).

targets.query: SELECT sum("w") FROM (SELECT last("watts") AS "w" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE time > now() - 5m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: Power draw

panels.description: Hosts that reported an IPMI power reading in the last 5 minutes. Should match Expected, unless a BMC does not support DCMI.

targets.query: SELECT count("w") FROM (SELECT last("watts") AS "w" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE time > now() - 5m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: Power sensors

panels.description: Jobs currently running on bare metal hosts.

targets.query: SELECT sum("j") FROM (SELECT last("running_jobs") AS "j" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: Running jobs

panels.description: Share of all bare metal CPUs currently given to jobs.

targets.query: SELECT sum("u") / sum("t") * 100 FROM (SELECT last("cpus_total") - last("cpus_free") AS "u", last("cpus_total") AS "t" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: CPUs allocated

panels.description: Hosts whose load average exceeds their CPU count, i.e. jobs run more threads than they requested.

targets.query: SELECT count("r") FROM (SELECT last("load") / last("cpus_total") AS "r" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host") WHERE "r" > 1

panels.title: Overloaded

panels.description: One row per host in the VGCN inventory; missing hosts sort to the top. Click a host name to show it in the host details above. Hover a column header for what it means.

value.title: Show this host in the host details

targets.query: SELECT last("in_condor") AS "in_pool", last("running_jobs") AS "jobs", (last("cpus_total") - last("cpus_free")) / last("cpus_total") * 100 AS "cpu_pct", last("cpus_total") AS "cpus", (last("memory_total_mb") - last("memory_free_mb")) / last("memory_total_mb") * 100 AS "mem_pct", last("memory_total_mb") / 1024 AS "mem", last("gpus_total") - last("gpus_free") AS "gpus_used", last("gpus_total") AS "gpus", last("load") / last("cpus_total") AS "load_ratio", last("state") AS "state" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE time > now() - 3m GROUP BY "host", "galaxygroup"
SELECT sum("d") AS "oom_24h" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("oom_kill")) AS "d" FROM "kernel_vmstat" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(1m), "host") GROUP BY "host"
SELECT last("watts") AS "power" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE time > now() - 5m GROUP BY "host"

panels.title: Bare metal hosts

panels.description: Energy used by all bare metal hosts in the last 24 hours. Counts from when power monitoring started (7 Oct 2026) until a full day of data exists.

targets.query: SELECT sum("e") FROM (SELECT integral("watts", 1h) AS "e" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY "host")

panels.title: Energy 24h

panels.description: Kernel OOM kills on all hosts in the last 24 hours. With CGROUP_MEMORY_LIMIT_POLICY = hard, nearly all are jobs exceeding their memory request.

targets.query: SELECT sum("d") FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("oom_kill")) AS "d" FROM "kernel_vmstat" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(1m), "host")

panels.title: OOM kills 24h

panels.description: When the lines separate, machines dropped out of HTCondor. If both drop, the monitor itself did not report.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "in pool" FROM (SELECT last("in_condor") AS "v" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT count("v") AS "expected" FROM (SELECT last("in_condor") AS "v" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Hosts in pool

panels.description: Share of all bare metal CPUs and memory given to jobs.

targets.query: SELECT sum("u") / sum("t") * 100 AS "CPUs" FROM (SELECT last("cpus_total") - last("cpus_free") AS "u", last("cpus_total") AS "t" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("u") / sum("t") * 100 AS "Memory" FROM (SELECT last("memory_total_mb") - last("memory_free_mb") AS "u", last("memory_total_mb") AS "t" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: CPU and memory allocation

panels.description: Kernel OOM kills per host and time step, stacked. Counter resets after a reboot are ignored.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("oom_kill")) FROM "kernel_vmstat" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: OOM kills by host

panels.description: Total power draw (left axis) against the share of CPUs given to jobs (right axis). The gap between them at low allocation is the idle cost of the cluster.

targets.query: SELECT sum("w") AS "Power" FROM (SELECT mean("watts") AS "w" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("u") / sum("t") * 100 AS "CPUs allocated" FROM (SELECT last("cpus_total") - last("cpus_free") AS "u", last("cpus_total") AS "t" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Power draw and CPU allocation

panels.description: CPU and memory share given to jobs on the selected host. Pick a host at the top, or click one in the table.

targets.query: SELECT (last("cpus_total") - last("cpus_free")) / last("cpus_total") * 100 AS "CPUs", (last("memory_total_mb") - last("memory_free_mb")) / last("memory_total_mb") * 100 AS "Memory" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE "host" = '$host' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Allocation · ${host}

panels.description: Running jobs (left) and load per CPU (right). Above the dashed line at 1, jobs run more threads than they requested.

targets.query: SELECT last("running_jobs") AS "Jobs", last("load") / last("cpus_total") AS "Load per CPU" FROM "htcondor_host_status" WHERE "host" = '$host' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Jobs and load · ${host}

panels.description: Power draw of the selected host.

targets.query: SELECT mean("watts") AS "Power" FROM "ipmi_power" WHERE "host" = '$host' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Power · ${host}

panels.description: Kernel OOM kills on the selected host.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("oom_kill")) AS "OOM kills" FROM "kernel_vmstat" WHERE "host" = '$host' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: OOM kills · ${host}
